California State Workers Strike Over Pay and Remote Work

Thousands of California state workers walked off the job to demand higher pay, better healthcare, and more flexibility to work from home. The strike specifically targets Governor Gavin Newsom's administration, with workers pressing for raises and the option to continue remote work arrangements. The core demands revolve around increased compensation and the ability to save money, as articulated by the striking employees.
